exact_scope: Sole research target is the FULL arbitrary-dimension quadratic-form bounded-density conjecture. The latest proved supporting theorem gives explicit density bounds for invertible physical triples with an indefinite physical face; it is not a full solution and does not prove continuity in general.
first_unproved_step: Splice an indefinite physical pair to a single or aggregate product-coordinate cross direction in the Schur residual without selecting a tiny local minor or assuming post-rotation independence.
next_mathematical_attempt: Use the completed account02/B04 determinant-rearrangement envelope to prove a quarter-Riesz potential bound for a Schur residual and combine it with the existing quarter-power conditional density estimate for an indefinite physical face.
